question: Should Bulgaria's navy escort merchant ships, yes or no?

lines.text: Drones have hit two cargo ships in Bulgaria's Black Sea economic zone, and one has sunk.
lines.note: Radev: two ships hit in Bulgaria's EEZ; Alfa Watan sank

lines.text: Prime Minister Rumen Radev says its crew is still missing.
lines.note: Radev: 'The crew remains missing, and the search continues'

lines.text: He says sea and air drones struck at about 3am, 70 nautical miles east of Byala.
lines.note: Euronews/BTA: sea and aerial drones, about 3am local, around 70 nautical miles east of Byala

lines.text: The sunken ship is the Togo-flagged Alfa Watan, owned by a Turkish firm.
lines.note: Turkiye Today: Togo-flagged Alfa Watan, Mersin-based Baraka Shipping; Al Jazeera: Togo-flagged

lines.text: The second ship, the Palau-flagged Able, was carrying wheat and caught fire.
lines.note: Turkiye Today: Palau-flagged Able, carrying wheat, caught fire

lines.text: Radev says all 18 crew, 11 Turkish and 7 Indian, were rescued.
lines.note: Turkiye Today: all 18 crew, 11 Turkish and seven Indian, rescued by the ferry Dioscuria

lines.text: Two injured sailors were taken by fast boat to Varna.
lines.note: Turkiye Today: two injured, taken by fast boat to Varna

lines.text: Radev called it a flagrant violation of maritime law.
lines.note: Euronews: 'a flagrant violation of maritime law'

scene.quote: a flagrant violation of maritime law

lines.text: He has not said who was behind it, Euronews reports.
lines.note: Euronews: He did not say who was behind the attack; no one has yet been blamed

lines.text: It came a day after a Turkish-owned grain ship sank off Romania.
lines.note: Euronews: a day after a Turkish-owned cargo ship carrying grain sank

lines.text: Insurers' Joint War Committee has widened the Black Sea high-risk zone nearly 2.4 times.
lines.note: Turkiye Today: Joint War Committee expanded the Black Sea high-risk zone by nearly 2.4 times

lines.text: Radev says it drives up insurance premiums and makes maritime traffic extremely difficult.
lines.note: Euronews: 'drives up insurance premiums, and makes maritime traffic extremely difficult'

lines.text: Two ships hit in two days. Should Bulgaria's navy escort merchant ships, yes or no?

sources.title: Bulgarian PM says drone attack on two ships is 'flagrant' breach of maritime law
11 Turkish sailors rescued, Alfa Watan crew still missing after Black Sea drone attack
Ship sinks off Bulgaria after drone attack in Black Sea

caption: Bulgaria, Black Sea: drones have hit two Turkish-owned cargo ships in Bulgaria's economic zone, and the Alfa Watan has sunk with its crew still missing. Prime Minister Rumen Radev calls it a flagrant violation of maritime law. Should Bulgaria's navy escort merchant ships, yes or no?
notes_full: First reported 6 Oct about 06:37 UTC (Reuters 06:48, Novinite 06:55, BNR 07:19), then Euronews, France 24, BBC, Politico, CBC, NYT, Al Jazeera, AFP; about 11.5h old at 19:00 UK delivery
Removal-risk: event that happened; no attacker named, framed as Radev/Euronews; no death toll; Radev's 'global conflict' warning left out (prediction); neutral yes/no
